title: How Sink Drainage Works: Gravity and Venting
description: Have you ever wondered how wastewater leaves your sink basin and travels smoothly down the drain? Sink drainage relies on two fundamental principles: gravity and atmospheric pressure working together. As water flows from the basin through the tailpiece and trap, it creates momentum. Simultaneously, the plumbing vent system allows air to enter the pipes, preventing negative pressure from sucking water out of the trap. Understanding this balanced mechanism helps you troubleshoot gurgling sounds, slow drainage, and unpleasant sewer gas odors in residential spaces.
